description: This file defines a React component 'AuthShell' for the authentication layout in a Next.js application, including subcomponents for panels and UI elements. It manages UI presentation for login/signup modes with animated effects.

methods.name: AuthShell
methods.description: Main component providing the two-panel authentication layout with animated accent background, depending on mode ('login' or 'signup'). It displays a header, main content, and panels with calls to action.
